intent: Eight original labor-procedure tasks join action/purpose,contrast a compliant cloth setup with a notebook-rule violation,read whether/if/before conditions,connect cleanup with readiness for the next person,resolve the Friday pair and decline unsupported blame. Fresh art-club transfer checks all three conditions without inferring an unreported action.
picturePurpose: Original identical-pot-on-cloth versus pot-on-notebook art supports opposite positive/negative rule questions. The text supplies the rule and purpose;pixels do not prove absorption,health changes,causes or completion. All labels and check states are coded.

workshop.title: 劳动不止做一步：读顺序，检查完整结果

items.label: 怎么做，起什么作用
items.prompt: What goes under a pot, and what does it do?
items.answer: A cloth goes under the pot to catch small drips and make wiping easier.
items.reason: 盆底先垫布，用来接住少量滴水，方便擦拭。先找到操作要求，再补上说明作用的那句。
items.hint: 按问题找顺序、条件、作用和完成要求；物品去向与检查职责不能混在一起。
items.material:
RESET THE PLANT SHELF
First, return all notebooks to the rack.
Put a cloth under each pot before watering.
The cloth catches small drips and makes the shelf easier to wipe.
Keep notebooks in the rack, not under a pot.
Check the soil before deciding whether to water.
If you are unsure what a plant needs, ask the teacher before adding water.
When the watering is done, wipe the shelf and return the bottle to the cupboard.
The job is finished only when the place is ready for the next person.
On Friday, Jia and Bo will check the corner together.
They will note any changes and report them to the teacher, rather than decide who is to blame.
A wet shelf or a changed leaf does not by itself tell them who caused a problem.

transfer.passage:
AFTER ART CLUB
Checklist: wash the brushes, leave the table dry, and return all materials to their labelled places before leaving.
Leah has washed the brushes. The table is still wet, and the materials remain beside the sink. She says, "The brushes are clean, so the whole job is finished."
transfer.stem: Which judgment matches both the checklist and the record?

options.text: Clean brushes prove that every checklist requirement has been met.
The brushes are clean, but the dry-table and storage requirements are not met yet.
Returning materials can be skipped because the brushes are clean.

answer.display: The brushes are clean, but the dry-table and storage requirements are not met yet.

explanation.strategy: 把清单的每项要求和现状逐一对应；一项完成不能替代其余要求。

steps.text: 刷子已洗净，满足第一项；但桌面仍湿，没有达到桌面干燥的要求。
steps.reason: 原文报告现状，不能把一项满足扩大成全部满足。

steps.text: 材料还在水池边，没有回到标记好的位置，所以整项工作尚未达到清单标准。
steps.reason: 材料归位是独立要求，不会因为刷子干净而自动取消。

distractors.reason: 只核对刷子一项，漏掉仍湿的桌面和未归位的材料。
清单明确要求材料归位，刷子干净不能取消这一项。

explanation.pitfall: 看要求是否满足，不凭一个好结果代替全部标准，也不从现状猜谁该受责怪。
